title: AI tools for affiliate managers: automating recruitment, outreach, fraud checks and onboarding
summary: Vic Giurgiu walks through the most time-consuming affiliate manager tasks (recruitment, email outreach, fake-follower checks, onboarding) and the AI tools he uses for each. He also shares how a teen founder balances school and building, and why outsourcing and growth-first thinking matter.

principles.text: Automate monotone, repetitive tasks so managers can focus on relationships and the human side of the role.
principles.quote: when it comes to like monotone tasks like repetitive workflow that's like where I like to begin to it look deeper and see is there any Tech out there that could help this person or this company save save time or save money

principles.text: Turn a brand URL into a large prospect list with AI discovery instead of manual keyword research and expensive SEO tools.
principles.quote: we can use a URL of a brand and turn it into a big L list of potential Affiliates that we can reach out to and this is only possible with the power of AI and with the power of machine learning and automation

principles.text: Personalize outreach at scale with AI icebreakers built from the prospect's own content, so it reads less like bulk email.
principles.quote: you can put their content example under my content variables in under my custom variables and instantly and tell it using like GPT or something like that tell it like make a compliment about their video

principles.text: Vet influencers for fake followers by checking engagement against industry benchmarks and looking for suspicious growth spikes.
principles.quote: if they bought followers or views at any point we can just look for Peaks uh in this one right here

principles.text: Train an AI chatbot on your materials and policies to handle repetitive affiliate support questions, escalating the rest to a human.
principles.quote: you can train a chatbot on your materials on your past work with affiliate on your policies and so on and then you can basically tell your Affiliates like you have any questions go ask this Ai

principles.text: Early on, prioritize growth over profitability and outsource what you can to build a quality team.
principles.quote: in the beginning k say just focus more on growth rather than profitability so if you can pay somebody to run your I don't know your social media do that if you can pay somebody to implement a feature for you do that
